verses.1: Praise the LORD, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.2: Let Israel say, “May His kindness be everlasting.”
verses.3: Please say to the house of Aaron, that His mercy is forever.
verses.4: Let them say, “The eyes of Jehovah are upon us, for his kindness lasts forever.”
verses.5: From the place of suffering, I called out to You, my Lord. In the vastness of space, I cried out to You.
verses.6: YHWH, I do not know what a man will do to me.
verses.7: May the LORD be my helper, and I will see in my sorrow.
verses.8: It is better to trust in Jehovah from a place of confidence in man.
verses.9: It is better to trust in God, rather than being dependent on generosity.
verses.10: All nations have called me by the name of Jehovah, because I am His.
verses.11: May I also be called by the name of Jehovah, for I am His beloved.
verses.12: My ancestors were destroyed like flames that are extinguished in the name of Jehovah. For they were weak.
verses.13: Save me from falling, and may Jehovah help me.
verses.14: May strength and song be with me, and may I be saved.
verses.15: May there be a voice of comfort and hope in the houses of the righteous. May Jehovah do so.
verses.16: The right side of Jehovah is beautiful; the right side of Jehovah creates life.
verses.17: It’s not true that I will live and still record the deeds of Yahweh.
verses.18: May You destroy me, O God! May death not be given to me.
verses.19: Open to me the doors of righteousness. I will enter through them.
verses.20: This gate of Jehovah will be opened for the righteous to enter.
verses.21: O God, because you answered me, it became a source of deliverance for me.
verses.22: Eben Masu was the head of those who built it.
verses.23: From Jehovah’s hand came this; it was glorious in our eyes.
verses.24: Today, Jehovah has made it possible for joy and celebration to occur.
verses.25: Oh LORD, please save me! Oh LORD, please help me!
verses.26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of Jehovah. Blessings be upon you from the house of Jehovah.
verses.27: Elohim, please grant us a time of rest during the days of Sukkot, until the time when we celebrate the Festival.
verses.28: You alone, and you alone, O God, are worthy of my worship.
verses.29: Praise the LORD, for His goodness lasts forever.
